Ganoderma sp.

I found this growing on a piece of deadwood by the lakeside in Hutan Kota Srengseng. The wood was already long gone and right next to it, Trametes sp. showed up too! Btw Ganoderman sp. is a white rot decomposer, they breaking down lignin and cellulose in deadwood. And witth Trametes, they help recycle nutrients back into the soil and the lakeside ecosystem.

Field notes
Location: Hutan Kota Srengseng, lakeside area
Habitat: Urban secondary forest
Substrate: Dead hardwood (water edge and constantly moist)

Morphology
Fruiting body: sessile
Shape: semicircular / kidney-shaped
Cap surface: smooth, slightly laccate
Margin: thick, rounded, pale
Context: firm, woody
Underside: poroid layer (white to pale cream)

Approx. size
Width: ± 4–6 cm
Thickness: ± 1–2 cm
